other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via test set feature encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits a feature encoder (e.g., frequency encoding) on the combined train and test datasets before cross-validation. This leaks information about the test set distribution into the training features, potentially causing overfitting to the test set.

summary: The agent correctly frames the task and implements a robust cross-validation strategy with basic feature engineering. However, there is a critical data leakage issue where frequency encoding is calculated using the combined train and test datasets, leaking test distribution information into the training features. Additionally, the agent uses a simple unweighted average for ensembling the fold models and relies entirely on a single evaluation metric.
